flora: Conifer cone (woody, spiraling scales, chunky texture)
Needle cluster (tufted, rounded tips, deep green)
Bark fragment (thick, layered, with stylized amber/resin drip)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; emphasis on 'clumped' needle groups rather than individual sharp points; tactile resin drips; chunky, satisfying bark geometry.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant layout: Top-Left: A mature woody cone; Top-Right: A cluster of needles; Bottom-Left: A vertical slab of bark with a drop of golden resin; Bottom-Right: Two winged seeds resting on the silt.
visual_logic.ground: A bed of dark forest peat and laminated paper-shale fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Studio-style soft lighting to emphasize the varied textures of wood, needle, and resin.
